test: read-only Windows CPU guard sample under a Deltic quiet lease

lease.granted_output: quiet window granted until 11:34 (local); 0 heavy workload processes running
quiet_before: 3 more heavy workload processes run at low priority (not counted).
quiet_after: 2 more heavy workload processes run at low priority (not counted).
lease.release_output: quiet window ended; the next grant is no earlier than 11:36 (local)
lease.status_after_release: quiet window open; 0 heavy workload processes and 2 low-priority heavy workloads

script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$started = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$quietBefore = (deltic quiet status)
$samples = @(Get-Counter -Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time' -SampleInterval 5 -MaxSamples 13 | ForEach-Object { $_.CounterSamples })
$values = @($samples | Select-Object -Skip 1 | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.CookedValue })
if ($values.Count -ne 12) { throw "expected 12 retained samples, got $($values.Count)" }
$logical = [int](Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).NumberOfLogicalProcessors
$mean = [double](($values | Measure-Object -Average).Average)
$busy = $mean * $logical / 100.0
$finished = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
$quietAfter = (deltic quiet status)
[pscustomobject]@{ host = $env:COMPUTERNAME; started_utc = $started; completed_utc = $finished; counter = '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time'; interval_seconds = 5; requested_samples = $samples.Count; skipped_initial = 1; retained_samples = $values.Count; logical_processors = $logical; percent_samples = $values; mean_percent = $mean; busy_logical_cores = $busy; guard_limit = 0.75; guard_pass = ($busy -le 0.75); quiet_before = $quietBefore; quiet_after = $quietAfter } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress
decision: Do not start speed or latency measurements: the 60-second busy-core sample measured 2.189920 against the 0.75 limit. End the lease immediately.
limits: This is a host-load guard sample, not codec speed or latency evidence.
No RVP9 encode, speed group, or latency measurement started.
The quiet lease was ended after the guard failed; the host returned to open status.
The remote source tree and its artifacts were inspected read-only; no source, binary, package, or system setting changed.
